label: Carriage of ESSENCE_6 exclusions at roots, from positive ESSENCE_6 at roots
meaning: Positivity gives every ESSENCE_6 condition on an actual root's profile at every admissible extension of that profile, so in particular at every such extension in which no root determination requires a lack. It certifies the strength order of the two premises. The main theorem uses no axioms. In the Comparator companion carriageControls, row 3 (the closure carried by the pure a, every pure profile admissible) satisfies carriage and fails positivity, so the order is strict on that assignment.
